cost.title: Cost
cost.text: The price of each building of a kind is the multiplier m times the one before it, starting from the price of the first. Buying n at once, when you own d, costs the sum of their prices.

vars: the coins the next n buildings cost
how many you buy at once
how many of this building you own
the price of the first building, shown above
